description: Editable exclusion, deprioritization, and duplicate-handling rules for future Relay selection. These rules guide later scoring and editorial review.

hard_exclusions.name: UFO and alien claims
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude UFO, alien, extraterrestrial, and unexplained-object claims.

hard_exclusions.name: Archaeology and ancient-discovery stories
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude archaeology, ancient artifacts, tombs, ruins, and historical discovery stories.

hard_exclusions.name: Celebrity and entertainment coverage
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude celebrity, film, television, music, awards, and entertainment-industry coverage.

hard_exclusions.name: Sports results
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude game results, standings, player transactions, and routine sports coverage.

hard_exclusions.name: Pornographic material
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude pornographic and sexually explicit material.

hard_exclusions.name: Obvious spam
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude keyword-stuffed, deceptive, automatically generated, or otherwise obvious spam pages.

hard_exclusions.name: Fabricated-news sites
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude sources known to publish fabricated stories while presenting them as factual news.

hard_exclusions.name: Affiliate-only pages
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude pages whose primary purpose is affiliate sales rather than original reporting.

hard_exclusions.name: Exact duplicate links
hard_exclusions.description: Exclude a link when the same normalized article URL has already been retained.

deprioritized_topics.name: Ordinary crime with no wider consequence
Stories selected only because they are sensational

deprioritization_override: A deprioritized story may still qualify when it has a meaningful effect on infrastructure, public safety, supply chains, essential services, health, finance, or a wider region.

normalized_url_matching.description: Compare canonicalized URLs after normalizing host, path, trailing slash, and other harmless URL variations.

tracking_parameter_removal.description: Remove common analytics, campaign, referral, and social tracking parameters before duplicate comparison.

similar_headline_detection.description: Flag strongly similar headlines for review instead of assuming they are different stories.

same_event_clustering.description: Group coverage of the same event so the board does not fill with repeated versions of one development.

prefer_original_reporting.description: Prefer the source that performed or first published the original reporting over rewrites and aggregations.

retain_confirming_source.description: Allow one important independent confirming source when it adds verification, local detail, official context, or a materially different perspective.
